title: Wild Life
description: Wild Life to Minecraft. Currently In-dev
body:
### **Wild Life**

**Image of a pair of giraffes**
![Image of a pair of giraffes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a6a20d66b1cf8f8280ed34140502d1a4dbcdc23.png)

Bring the safari to your Minecraft world! The **Wild Life Mod** populates your game with magnificent new creatures, starting with the towering **Giraffes** you can spot roaming the savanna. This mod is focused on introducing realistic, naturally-spawning wildlife.

**Next up:** Adorable, waddling **Penguins** are coming soon to an icy biome near you!


**Two giraffes in a hill**

![Two giraffes in a hill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/640f19aa8b9b4ae1d5b09a95d5a38ac734bdffb2.png)
**Get ready to explore a wilder world!**
